tables.name: pylon-blog-app
tables.sdl:
type Query {
  me: User
  post(id: String!): Post
  posts(filter: PostsFilterInput!): [Post!]!
  search(query: String!): [SearchResult!]!
  feed: [Post!]!
}

type Mutation {
  createPost(input: CreatePostInput!): Post!
  addComment(postId: String!, input: AddCommentInput!): Comment!
  publishPosts(ids: [String!]!): [Post!]!
}

type User implements SearchResult {
  id: String!
  name: String!
  email: String
  role: Role!
  avatar: Image
}

type Media implements IMedia {
  id: String!
  url: String!
}

type Image implements IMedia {
  width: Number!
  height: Number!
  altText: String
  id: String!
  url: String!
}

type Post implements SearchResult {
  id: String!
  title: String!
  body: String!
  status: PostStatus!
  author: User!
  tags: [String!]!
  comments: [Comment!]!
  media: [IMedia!]!
  trailer: Video
  related: [Post!]!
  tagMatrix: [[String!]!]!
  createdAt: Date!
}

type Comment {
  id: String!
  body: String!
  author: User!
  replies: [Comment!]!
  createdAt: Date!
}

type Video implements IMedia {
  durationSeconds: Number!
  captions: [String!]!
  id: String!
  url: String!
}

input PostsFilterInput {
  status: PostStatus
  tag: String
  limit: Number
}

input CreatePostInput {
  title: String!
  body: String!
  tags: [String!]!
  status: PostStatus
}

input AddCommentInput {
  body: String!
}

interface SearchResult {
  id: String!
}

interface IMedia {
  id: String!
  url: String!
}

  """The locale for this operation, e.g. `en` or `de-AT`."""
  locale: String
